name: kernel-collection-tools
summary: PureDarwin kernel collection and interface generation tooling (iig-tools, kc-tools, xnu-loader) pinned jointly by sources.lock.json and the PureDarwin flake lock.

license.notes: sources.lock.json records BSD-3-Clause for iig-tools, kc-tools, and xnu-loader.

isolation: Build-time tools supplied by the pinned PureDarwin flake; revisions must agree between sources.lock.json and manifests/puredarwin-flake.lock. Nixpkgs/compiler transitive inputs follow the flake lock recorded under transitive_locks.

rebuild.note: Pins are cross-validated against both lock files by scripts/build/packages.py; a clean Nix rebuild is remaining work and requires the operator-supplied macOS11.3 SDK recorded in toolchain.lock.json.
